Hi Tom,

Great catching up yesterday. Quick recap and next steps so we can get the technical deep dive on the calendar:

What we heard:
- Goal: run inference inside your VPC to meet latency and data residency requirements.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) preferred.
- Target throughput: 100 qps baseline, bursts to ~500 qps.

Next step: 30-45 minute architecture review with our Solutions Engineer to go through topology options, peering, firewall rules, and key management. Proposed slots (PT):
1) Tue, Mar 28 10:00 AM
2) Wed, Mar 29 02:00 PM

If neither works, please pick any open slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/30min

Attendees from our side: me and Neha Kapoor (Solutions Engineer). Can you confirm who from infra/security will attend and, if possible, share a redacted network diagram ahead of time? I attached a short draft architecture and a security questionnaire to speed the review.

Thanks,
